title: Automotive Life-Cycle Assessment Reference Data Pack (Research snapshot: 18 October 2026)
publisher: Techfest IIT Bombay 2026-27 Challenge 2 / Green Auto India Reference Pack

title: European Commission Impact Assessment Working Document SWD(2023) 256 — Vehicle Composition Section (JRC-RMIS & Argonne GREET 2021)
page_table: PDF Page 2, Section 3 Table (1,137 kg depolluted passenger car)
notes: Published European end-of-life passenger-car composition dataset scaled to 1,137 kg after depollution across ICEV, HEV, PHEV, and BEV. Useful as a transparent representative baseline, not a BOM for a named current Indian model.

title: Predicting Design Solutions with Scenarios Considering the Quality of Materials and Products Based on a Life Cycle Assessment (LCA)
publisher: Peer-Reviewed Open-Access Article (PMC10890010) citing GREET and literature
page_table: PDF Page 2, Section 4, Table 4 (1,532 kg reference passenger car)
notes: Reports process energy (MJ/kg processed) and CO2 emissions (kg CO2/kg processed). High values (e.g. painting, welding, HVAC) represent allocated facility energy/services per kg, not direct process-only emissions.

title: Global Hydrogen Review 2024 — GHG emissions of hydrogen and its derivatives
notes: Provides global production emission ranges for hydrogen from unabated natural gas (10-12 kg CO2e/kg H2) and unabated coal (22-26 kg CO2e/kg H2). Not a universal India-specific value.
